segment.source: PK Spot asks only for an age range, such as under 13, 13–17 or 18+. PK Spot does not ask Apple for your exact age or birthday. It stores the age band, a broad evidence category and the resulting eligibility—not an exact birth date, identity document, bank account or card number. It also records the provider and method category, when the result was checked, and the policy basis used for the decision. This lets PK Spot withdraw approvals if a later signal changes or a method is found unsuitable. Self-declared age alone does not unlock a public profile.

También registra el proveedor y la categoría del método, cuándo se comprobó el resultado y la base de la política utilizada para la decisión.
